task: PrimeKG/KG existing-drug indication ranking with Graph CGI e50
default_command: bash score.sh "diabetic retinopathy" output_scores.csv python auto 100

input_schema.disease: Required. A disease_id or exact disease_name from prepared/disease_catalog.csv, which is built from graph_diseases.csv.
input_schema.top_k: Optional. 0 or omitted means all candidates; positive integer means first K rows.
input_schema.device: Optional. auto, cpu, cuda, or mps.
input_schema.candidate_drugbank_ids: Optional text file with one DrugBank ID per line; every ID must exist in candidate_pool.csv.

limitations: Only supports drugs already present in the fitted PrimeKG candidate_pool.
Does not support arbitrary SMILES or KG-external new-drug cold start.
Scores are model ranking outputs, not clinical treatment recommendations.
Disease names must match disease_catalog.csv exactly after whitespace/case normalization.

source_code.notes: Lightweight helper modules are copied into the Graph CGI package; torch, dgl and rdkit remain required runtime dependencies.
source_code.kg_project_src_requirement: Set KG_PROJECT_SRC to the src directory from the GitHub clone or extracted source archive.

environment.dgl: required by inference source; missing from the current venv

data_packaging.raw_data_notes: Raw PrimeKG, DrugBank, CMap/CGI and disease embedding files are not required for scoring; they are required only for rebuilding prepared data or retraining.
